result.note: Tests the scope and features of the WTO Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies, which India accepted in July 2026.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, India deposited its instrument of acceptance for the WTO Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies. Consider the following statements about the agreement:
items: It is the first WTO pact with an environmental sustainability objective.
It bans subsidies tied to illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing and to overfished stocks.
Aquaculture and inland fisheries fall within its scope.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because aquaculture and inland fisheries stay outside the agreement's scope. That exclusion shields India's shrimp exports, the bulk of its seafood trade. India became the 123rd member to join.
questions.source: Aquaculture and inland fisheries stay outside its scope, which shields India's shrimp exports, the bulk of its seafood trade.
